main_text.p: quidem vilâ, vel odore perceptâ, haud præter rationem quis speciem dixerit, repræsentativam quodammodo quali-tatum occultarum, (ut loqui solemus,) à fele vel similî quocunque subjecto promanantem: At dum species ipsifmet subjectis, à quibus diffundi dicuntur, ineffe credit Sennertus, ac duntaxat simplicibus quibufdam, & rebus naturalibus, non arte compositis, vim data tam à natura ejufmodi species emittendi, exiftimat, certè in errore verfatur, ac oftendit fe ignorare quid per species intelligat. Nam similiter contra ipfum poffem urgere, vel fubftantias effe illas fpecies, adeòque ἀπορροίας feu effluvia corporea è corporibus emiffa, quibus originaliter ineffe ipfi Sennerto credun-tur, qualia ipfe impugnat, quæ fimilibus paffim rationibus caderent; vel effe accidentia, quæ utique è fubjectis effundi non poffent. Eft ergo species, quæ vulgò dicitur diffundi à fubjectis, affectio quædam, repræsentativa fub-jecti

page.notes: Greek word in the printed line "ἀπορροίας" is read as best possible; the 'ἀπορροίας' form is uncertain. Some words in the first lines are partly obscured by the binding and are read with doubt.
